purpose: Matched non-neural controls for the frozen PROSTATEx T2, ADC, and paired-patch CNN baselines

inputs.stored_values: Unnormalized source stored values; all learned scaling is fitted on training folds only
feature_definition: Global mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, 10th/25th/50th/75th/90th percentiles, and exact-zero fraction

split_protocol.tie_rule: First candidate in the frozen grid

logistic.pipeline: StandardScaler plus class-weighted liblinear logistic regression

rbf_svm.pipeline: StandardScaler plus class-weighted probability-enabled RBF SVM

analyses.sensitivity: ADC and paired models retrained after removing ProstateX-0052 finding 1 from every split

uncertainty.method: Patient-level percentile bootstrap of complete out-of-fold predictions

interpretation: These models are controls for the fixed CNN, not radiomics models and not clinical diagnostic systems.
